checks.name: Interrupted capture reconnects and preserves capture scope
Startup failures back off and recover when a source returns
Sleep stops capture; wake recreates it exactly once
Screen sleep waits for wake; system sleep remains authoritative
Real workspace notification observers forward sleep and wake
Display and output-route bursts are coalesced
Stop cancels pending retry and suppresses wake recovery
macOS user-stop is respected until explicitly restarted
Explicit start works after stopping while asleep
Permission denial polls without repeating capture requests
Idle output without PCM is not mistaken for a stalled capture
Silent PCM remains healthy for long periods
Missing PCM during active output automatically rebuilds capture
Fresh PCM bypasses device queries while stalled PCM still triggers recovery
An old output-device query cannot affect a reconnected capture
Callbacks from old captures cannot change the new scene or reconnect it
Stopping a pending factory never starts a late capture
Stopping an in-flight start cleans up its late completion
A healthy interval restores the short retry delay
Mixture is default; source switches replace capture once and respect a stopped engine
A replacement survives the old in-flight start completing later

method: injected capture transport, actual retry tasks, workspace notifications and controlled monotonic clock; no machine sleep or device changes
